reasons: The file defines data shapes only and does not show any validation tests.
Changing a label or field here affects stored data, but the packet does not show a migration path for existing saves.

terms.meaning: The agreed layout of a record, including its field names and types.
A fixed list of allowed values, such as high, medium or low, so typos cannot slip in.
A library that checks that data matches its declared shape and types.
A group that contains only one activity.
The share of schedule links whose two ends fall in the same group.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Version number and imports
sections.what: Sets the version number for this data format and loads the tools that define data shapes.
sections.why: Likely reason: a version number lets the app recognise saved results made with an older format.
sections.watch_out: Changing the version number does not convert old saved results by itself.

sections.name: Materiality
sections.title: Physical or abstract label
sections.what: Defines the two allowed materiality values: physical for real construction work and abstract for paperwork or schedule markers.
sections.why: Likely reason: every activity needs one of two clear answers so the 3D view can separate them.
sections.watch_out: The text values are stored, so renaming one breaks existing saves.

sections.name: Confidence
sections.title: Confidence levels
sections.what: Defines the three confidence levels: high, medium and low.
sections.why: Likely reason: the app needs a simple way to flag uncertain results for review.
sections.watch_out: The service adds low confidence items to the review queue, so removing the low level would change that flow.

sections.name: Phase
sections.title: Construction phase labels
sections.what: Defines the list of construction phases, from enabling work through testing, commissioning and management, plus an unknown phase for anything else.
sections.why: Likely reason: phases give the timeline and colour coding a common set of stages.
sections.watch_out: The label table in the frontend must include every phase here, or the screen will fail to build.

sections.name: StructureClass
sections.title: Structure class labels
sections.what: Defines the eight structure classes that the 3D view can show, such as below ground, concrete, steel frame, and open area.
sections.why: Likely reason: each class maps to a different kind of shape, so the set must match what the 3D view can draw.
sections.watch_out: The classifier uses these same values, so a new class must be added in both places.

sections.name: ActivitySemantics
sections.title: Activity result record
sections.what: Defines the saved result for one activity, with its project, identifier, materiality, phase, discipline, confidence, evidence words and reason.
sections.why: Likely reason: one standard record per activity lets every stage read the same fields.
sections.watch_out: Unknown fields are rejected, so any new field must be added here before it is written.

sections.name: GroupingCandidateScore
sections.title: Grouping strategy score record
sections.what: Defines the score card for one way of grouping activities, with its score, coverage, group counts, share of singletons and largest group, dependency lift, phase variety, spatial evidence, and whether it was selected.
sections.why: Likely reason: the user and reviewers need to see why one grouping method was chosen over the others.
sections.watch_out: The selected flag is set later by the service, not by this record, so it defaults to not selected.

sections.name: FacilityHypothesis
sections.title: Facility guess record
sections.what: Defines the best guess for the facility type, with its label, score, confidence, the closest alternate, the evidence words and the limits of the guess.
sections.why: Likely reason: a facility guess is only useful if the user can see how sure it is and what it is not based on.
sections.watch_out: The limitations list is what warns the user that the guess is schedule-based, so it should not be left empty.

sections.name: SemanticReport
sections.title: Project semantic report record
sections.what: Defines the whole-project summary: activity counts, physical and abstract counts, all grouping scores, the chosen grouping method, the facility guess and the number of items waiting for review.
sections.why: Likely reason: this is the one record the app loads to show the project's semantic analysis.
sections.watch_out: The review count is set by the service, so a mismatch there would not be caught by this file.

summary: Defines the shape of the saved results for semantic analysis, including the labels for each stage, the classes for each activity and the report for a whole project.
purpose: Gives every part of the app one agreed format for activity labels, grouping scores, facility guesses and project reports.
why: Likely reason: a fixed, versioned format lets saved results be read later and checked against a version number.
how: Defines a version number, then defines short sets of allowed labels for materiality, confidence, phase and structure class. Then defines record shapes for one activity, one grouping strategy score, one facility guess and one project report. Each record refuses unknown fields.
inputs: Values from the classifier, the grouping scorer and the facility classifier.
outputs: Validated records that can be turned into text for storage and read back.
risks: Changing a label or field name breaks saved results and any screen that reads them. Records refuse unknown fields, so adding a field in one place fails elsewhere until every reader is updated.
debug: If saved results fail to load, compare the stored version number and field names with this file. If a label looks wrong in the screen, check the matching label table in the frontend and the phase names here.
